activityRules.positive30dRule: Positive category-compatible 30-day observation at this capture establishes activity occurrence within enclosing 90-day window, not a 90-day total. DEX volume is usage evidence. Positive fees is separately retained but not treated as literal user activity without adapter methodology validation.
activityRules.missingOrErrorRule: Missing/null/error is unknown; never zero or exclusion.
activityRules.lineageRule: Source IDs/slugs/explicit parentProtocol/linkedProtocols retained. No name-based product, protocol alias, or version merging. Canonical product identity unresolved unless explicitly source-verified.
activityRules.tvlRule: TVL is not used as activity or exclusion.

methodology.Volume: Stakes paid by bettors on sportsbook tickets and Speed Markets positions (and legacy Thales digital options), excluding protocol-funded free bets and casino wagers.
methodology.NotionalVolume: Maximum payout of the sportsbook tickets and Speed Markets positions bought, excluding protocol-funded free bets.
methodology.Fees: What bettors lost to the house on settled sportsbook, casino and Speed Markets bets (stakes minus payouts, less winnings paid on protocol-funded free bets), negative when bettors win more than they lose; before 2026-07-21, while the sportsbook pools were shared with external liquidity providers, the sportsbook only counts its SafeBox trading fee and the SafeBox share of profitable pool rounds.
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus sportsbook and casino referral fees, all kept by the Overtime treasury, which has been the only sportsbook liquidity provider since 2026-07-21 (OIP-265) and has always funded the casino and Speed Markets bankrolls. Speed Markets referral fees are not tracked and are not deducted.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Referral fees paid to the referrers of bettors on the sportsbook and casino. Speed Markets referral fees are not tracked.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Stablecoins (USDC, sUSD before December 2024) spent by the SafeBoxBuyback contracts to buy back and burn OVER (THALES before the token migration).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue minus what is spent on OVER buybacks, i.e. what stays in the treasury, negative when buybacks or bettor wins exceed the period's revenue.

Fees.Sportsbook Gross Gaming Revenue: From 2026-07-21: buy-in minus final payout (winnings, cash-out or refund) of every sportsbook ticket settled in the period, excluding free bet tickets.
Fees.Sportsbook Trading Fees: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox fee charged on sportsbook ticket buy-ins, including the share paid to referrers.
Fees.Sportsbook LP Performance Fees: Before 2026-07-21: share of each profitable weekly liquidity pool round sent to the SafeBox.
Fees.Casino Gross Gaming Revenue: Stakes minus payouts of casino bets (Roulette, Dice, Blackjack, Baccarat, Slots and the CasinoCoreV2 games: Plinko, Hi-Lo, Keno, Video Poker, Three Card Poker, Ultimate and Bonus Hold'em, Penalty Shootout), excluding free bets.
Fees.Speed Markets Gross Gaming Revenue: Buy-in plus SafeBox and LP fees minus payout of every Speed Markets and Chained Speed Markets position resolved in the period, excluding free bets.
Fees.Free Bet Winnings: Net winnings paid to users on protocol-funded free bets (negative).

Revenue.Sportsbook Gross Gaming Revenue To Proto: From 2026-07-21: sportsbook result kept by the protocol, the treasury being the only liquidity provider, net of referral fees.
Revenue.Sportsbook Trading Fees To SafeBox: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox fee on sportsbook buy-ins, net of the referral share.
Revenue.Sportsbook LP Performance Fees To SafeBo: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox share of profitable liquidity pool rounds.
Revenue.Casino Gross Gaming Revenue To Protocol: Casino result kept by the treasury-funded bankrolls, net of referral fees.
Revenue.Speed Markets Gross Gaming Revenue To Pr: Speed Markets result kept by the treasury-funded AMMs. Referral fees paid out of the SafeBox fee on referred positions are not tracked and are not deducted.
Revenue.Free Bet Winnings Paid By Protocol: Net winnings paid to users on protocol-funded free bets (negative).

SupplySideRevenue.Sportsbook Referral Fees To Referrers: Share of the sportsbook SafeBox fee paid to the referrer of the bettor.
SupplySideRevenue.Casino Referral Fees To Referrers: Share of lost casino stakes paid to the referrer of the player.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Stablecoins (USDC, sUSD before December 2024) spent by the SafeBoxBuyback contracts to buy back and burn OVER (THALES before the migration).

ProtocolRevenue.Sportsbook Gross Gaming Revenue To Proto: From 2026-07-21: sportsbook result kept by the protocol, net of referral fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Sportsbook Trading Fees To SafeBox: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox fee on sportsbook buy-ins, net of the referral share.
ProtocolRevenue.Sportsbook LP Performance Fees To SafeBo: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox share of profitable liquidity pool rounds.
ProtocolRevenue.Casino Gross Gaming Revenue To Protocol: Casino result kept by the treasury-funded bankrolls, net of referral fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Speed Markets Gross Gaming Revenue To Pr: Speed Markets result kept by the treasury-funded AMMs, not net of referral fees (not tracked).
ProtocolRevenue.Free Bet Winnings Paid By Protocol: Net winnings paid to users on protocol-funded free bets (negative).
ProtocolRevenue.Token Buy Back: Stablecoins spent on OVER buybacks, moved to holders revenue (negative).

methodology.Revenue: Protocol cut: Aquila V2 ~5 bps (1/6 of LP fee) on OP/Arb/Base where factory.feeTo is set, 0 on mainnet; CLMM V3 read live per-pool per-timeslot from pool.slot0().feeProtocol (currently 1/6 on the Arbitrum and Base pools checked, 0 where the fee switch is off), so historical periods before any fee-switch change are attributed correctly; Classic 100% of the 2 bps taker fee.

CLMM whatever's left after the live per-pool pool.slot0().feeProtocol cut (currently ~5/6 where the fee switch is on). Classic and Gladius have no LP layer.
methodology.Volume: Total daily trading volume across Rubicon's four systems: Aquila V2 (UniV2-fork AMM, Swap events on pairs), CLMM V3 (UniV3-fork concentrated liquidity, Swap events on pools), Classic (RubiconMarket order book, LogTake/emitTake events; currently dormant), and Gladius (UniswapX-fork RFQ reactor, Fill events resolved to filler→swapper ERC20 transfers).

Fees.Gladius: All taker fees collected by the Rubicon fee wallet.

methodology.Volume: The value of tokens Sablier Lockup actually paid out to stream recipients each day, added up per chain. Cancelling a stream is not counted: it returns the unvested remainder to whoever funded the stream, and the recipient's already-vested share stays in the contract until they claim it, at which point that claim is counted. Streams are fully funded up front, so every payout is real money moving. Lockup is used almost entirely for project-token vesting, so daily figures are lumpy and driven by vesting unlocks.

Recurring subscription payments settled to recipients, summed on-chain from SubscriptionProcessed events of the AxiumPass SubscriptionVault contracts (v1 and v2) on each chain. Only the stablecoins AxiumPass offers at checkout are counted (USDC, USDT, EURC — per-chain allowlist in the adapter): the v1 vault is permissionless on the token argument, so any other ERC-20 that reached it is excluded rather than reported as subscription volume, which keeps the reported figure denominated in the tokens named here. Each counted amount is pulled from the subscriber and forwarded 100% to the recipient in the same transaction. The vaults are non-custodial and charge no on-chain fee, so no fees/revenue is reported. Limitation: the v1 vault is also permissionless on enrolment, so a subscription created from an address to itself is indistinguishable on-chain from a merchant payment and is counted; excluding it would require filtering on AxiumPass's enrolled-recipient set, which is not present in the logs.

methodology.Fees: Net gaming revenue (NGR) settled to the bankroll, measured as WINR received via ProfitReceived minus WINR paid out via LossCovered. This is an NGR figure standing in for a Fees field that conventionally carries GGR: gross wagered turnover is not observable on-chain because games run off-chain, and creator rewards, affiliate commissions and VIP cashback are already deducted in the off-chain escrow ledger before settlement. NGR is the most complete figure derivable from chain data, and this is a known limitation rather than an omission.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Equal to Fees. All settled net gaming revenue accrues to bankroll liquidity providers through share price appreciation; there is no separate distribution transaction.
methodology.Revenue: Zero. No protocol share is deducted on-chain - a 30 day reconciliation shows 100% of settled net gaming revenue accruing to bankroll liquidity providers through share price appreciation, with no leakage to any other on-chain party. The protocol does capture revenue at the application layer, but it is charged and accounted entirely off-chain and is not derivable from chain data, so it is deliberately not estimated here.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Zero, for the same reason as Revenue: no protocol share is taken on-chain, and application-layer revenue is not observable from chain data.

Fees.Net Gaming Revenue: WINR received by the bankroll via ProfitReceived minus WINR paid out via LossCovered, per ~5 minute settlement.

SupplySideRevenue.Net Gaming Revenue To LPs: The same net amount, accruing to bankroll liquidity providers through share price appreciation rather than a distribution transaction.

Revenue.Bribes to holders: Bribes paid by protocols to holders

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees to holders: User fees are distributed among holders.
HoldersRevenue.Bribes to holders: Bribes paid by protocols to holders
HoldersRevenue.Sarcophagus fee reclassification: Reclassifies fees already accrued as protocol revenue into holder revenue when funded to Sarcophagus.

methodology.Fees: Total yield generated by vault strategies, including depositor yield, curator fees and T3tris treasury profit.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Value flowing to capital providers and the third-party vault curator: net depositor yield + curator performance, management, entry and exit fees. The curator is not t3tris.
methodology.Revenue: Earnings sent to the T3tris treasury. Third-party services are also T3tris revenue but are not observable on-chain.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Earnings sent to the T3tris treasury. Third-party services are also T3tris revenue but are not observable on-chain.

Fees.Vault Yield: Gross yield from vault strategies (depositor yield plus curator performance and management fees).
Fees.Entry Fees: Fees charged on deposits, collected by the vault curator.
Fees.Exit Fees: Fees charged on withdrawals, collected by the vault curator.
Fees.T3tris Treasury Profit: Assets transferred to the t3treasury (T3trisProfit events).

SupplySideRevenue.Depositor Yield: Net yield earned by vault depositors after all fees are deducted.
SupplySideRevenue.Curator Performance Fees: Performance fees paid to the third-party vault curator (feeRecipient).
SupplySideRevenue.Curator Management Fees: Management fees paid to the third-party vault curator (feeRecipient).
SupplySideRevenue.Curator Entry Fees: Entry fees paid to the third-party vault curator (feeRecipient).
SupplySideRevenue.Curator Exit Fees: Exit fees paid to the third-party vault curator (feeRecipient).

Revenue.T3tris Treasury Profit: Assets transferred to the t3treasury (T3trisProfit events).

ProtocolRevenue.T3tris Treasury Profit: Assets transferred to the t3treasury (T3trisProfit events).

methodology.Fees: Includes transfer fees, gas fees and transaction fees, exact breakdown isn't available onchain

Fees.Gateway Fees: Fees collected for the transfer of funds through the Circle Gateway

methodology.Volume: Sell-side value of each swap executed through DashsWallet collateral, debt, repay, compound and morpho swap adapters across 7 chains, denominated in the source token.
methodology.Fees: Total surplus captured on DashsWallet swaps — difference between actual swap output and the user's minimum accepted amount.
methodology.Revenue: Portion of surplus retained by the DashsWallet treasury after deducting cashback.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Portion of surplus retained by the DashsWallet treasury after deducting cashback (the treasury is the protocol; no holder split).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Portion of surplus returned to the swap-initiating user as cashback.

Fees.Swap Surplus: Difference between actual swap output and the user's minimum accepted amount across DashsWallet swaps.

Revenue.Swap Surplus To Treasury: Portion of surplus retained by the DashsWallet treasury after deducting cashback.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Surplus Cashback To User: Portion of surplus returned to the swap-initiating user as cashback.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Surplus To Treasury: Portion of surplus retained by the DashsWallet treasury after deducting cashback (the treasury is the protocol; no holder split).

methodology.Fees: Ophis fees assessed on successfully settled Ophis-attributed fills, including the 1 bp base fee and capped price-improvement capture. Values come from Ophis' settlement-fill ledger, are bucketed by settlement date, and are valued in USD by the reporting indexer.
methodology.Revenue: Fees retained by Ophis. Ophis-operated chains retain the full fee; on CoW-hosted chains this is net of CoW Protocol's 25% partner-fee share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue retained by Ophis after CoW Protocol's hosted-chain share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: CoW Protocol's 25% share of Ophis fees on CoW-hosted chains; zero on Ophis-operated chains.

Fees.Ophis swap fees: Base and capped price-improvement fees assessed on successfully settled Ophis fills.

Revenue.Ophis protocol revenue: Fees retained by Ophis after any hosted-chain share.

ProtocolRevenue.Ophis protocol revenue: Fees retained by Ophis after any hosted-chain share.

SupplySideRevenue.CoW Protocol hosted-chain share: CoW Protocol's share on CoW-hosted chains.

methodology.Volume: Sum of totalAmount (the pre-fee swap notional a user commits, in tokenIn) from every SwapWithFee event emitted by the TeraSwapFeeCollector proxy, the contract that collects the 0.1% on-chain before the trade is forwarded to the underlying DEX router. On Ethereum mainnet this aggregates both FeeCollector deployments — the frozen V1 contract and the live V2 contract that replaced it — so mainnet's reported history is continuous back to TeraSwap's first on-chain swap rather than starting at the V2 cutover. Not all TeraSwap volume reaches that contract: routes filled by 0x, CoW Swap and Bebop collect the identical 0.1% through those venues' own partner-fee parameters instead of the FeeCollector, emit no SwapWithFee event, and are therefore NOT counted here.
methodology.Fees: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap, read directly from the feeAmount field of each SwapWithFee event (no estimation — the exact on-chain value).
methodology.Revenue: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap, read directly from the feeAmount field of each SwapWithFee event (no estimation — the exact on-chain value).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap, read directly from the feeAmount field of each SwapWithFee event (no estimation — the exact on-chain value).

Fees.Token Swap Fees: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap.

methodology.Volume: USD value of finalized swaps routed through 7.exchange in the period, credited to the source chain of each swap.
methodology.Fees: Integrator fees charged by 7.exchange on finalized swaps (the integrator_fee item). Excludes gas, relayer, and other third-party costs.
methodology.Revenue: All integrator fees charged by 7.exchange are retained by 7.exchange, so revenue equals fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All integrator fees charged by 7.exchange are retained by 7.exchange, so protocol revenue equals fees.

Fees.Integrator Fees: Integrator fees charged by 7.exchange on finalized swaps (the integrator_fee item).

Revenue.Integrator Fees: Integrator fees charged by 7.exchange on finalized swaps (the integrator_fee item).

ProtocolRevenue.Integrator Fees: Integrator fees charged by 7.exchange on finalized swaps (the integrator_fee item).

methodology.Fees: A 0.25% integrator fee is charged on the input token of every swap routed through DropSwap, recorded per chain in DropSwap's own database.
methodology.Revenue: Includes part of integrator fees retained by the protocol and part of integrator fees used to fund $DROP buybacks and burns.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Part of integrator fees retained by the protocol.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Part of integrator fees used to fund $DROP buybacks and burns.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Part of integrator fees used to fund swap campaigns.

Fees.Integrator Fees: A 0.25% integrator fee is charged on the input token of every swap routed through DropSwap, recorded per chain in DropSwap's own database.

Revenue.Integrator Fees to Token Buybacks: Part of integrator fees used to fund $DROP buybacks and burns.
Revenue.Integrator Fees to Protocol: Part of integrator fees retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Integrator Fees to Protocol: Part of integrator fees retained by the protocol.

HoldersRevenue.Integrator Fees to Token Buybacks: Part of integrator fees used to fund $DROP buybacks and burns.

SupplySideRevenue.Integrator Fees to Swap Campaigns: Part of integrator fees used to fund swap campaigns.

methodology.Fees: Total Aqua swap fees paid by takers: each fill's taker-paid amount (Pushed event on the AquaRouter registry, fee-inclusive; strategy-registration pushes excluded) multiplied by the position's fee rate decoded from its on-chain strategy bytecode (SwapVM flat-fee instruction, 1e9 units = 100%). Fills of positions on the legacy developer-release registry (pre-2026-07-19, a handful of test positions on an earlier instruction set) are excluded.
methodology.Revenue: The 1inch DAO's encoded share of each fill's swap fee: 1/4 of the LP fee on low-fee tiers (below ~0.1225%) and 1/6 on higher tiers, transferred to the purpose-deployed per-chain DAO fee exchanger at fill time. Positions created before the DAO fee launch (2026-07-19; enabled 2026-07-21 on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain) carry no DAO fee and contribute only to SupplySideRevenue. Cross-checked against measured ERC20 inflows to the fee exchangers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All DAO revenue accrues to the 1inch DAO treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of each fill's swap fee retained by the LP inside the maker-owned wallet (Aqua is non-custodial): total fee minus the DAO share.

Fees.Aqua LP Swap Fees: Swap-fee share retained by LPs in their own wallets, priced per fill from the decoded position fee rate.
Fees.1inch DAO Fee Share: Swap-fee share transferred to the 1inch DAO fee exchanger at fill time, priced per fill from the decoded protocol-fee rate.

SupplySideRevenue.Aqua LP Swap Fees: LP-retained swap fees (total fee minus the DAO share).

Revenue.1inch DAO Fee Share: The DAO's decoded per-fill fee share (validated against fee-exchanger inflows).

ProtocolRevenue.1inch DAO Fee Share: DAO fee share accruing to the 1inch DAO treasury.

methodology.Fees: x402 pay-per-call fees paid by AI agents for Barker's MCP stablecoin-yield tools ($0.001–$0.05 per call), settled onchain in stablecoins to the protocol payment wallet.
methodology.Revenue: All x402 call fees paid by AI agents are kept by the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All x402 call fees paid by AI agents are kept by the protocol.

Fees.x402 Call Fees: Per-call x402 payments by AI agents for MCP yield data, routing and execution-quote tools.

Revenue.x402 Call Fees: All x402 call fees paid by AI agents are kept by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.x402 Call Fees: All x402 call fees paid by AI agents are kept by the protocol.

methodology.Fees: Total Uniswap V3 trading fees earned by all AutoRange vaults' positions, realized on rebalance or when the vault owner manually claims — the full amount before the platform/owner split.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's performance-fee cut of those trading fees, set per-vault by PlatformConfig and capped by the vault owner.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's performance-fee cut of those trading fees, set per-vault by PlatformConfig and capped by the vault owner.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The vault owner's (LP's) net share of trading fees, after the platform's cut.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Total Uniswap V3 trading fees earned by all AutoRange vaults' positions, realized on rebalance or when the vault owner manually claims — the full amount before the platform/owner split.
Fees.Performance Fees: The platform's performance-fee cut of those trading fees, set per-vault by PlatformConfig and capped by the vault owner.

Revenue.Performance Fees: The platform's performance-fee cut of those trading fees, set per-vault by PlatformConfig and capped by the vault owner.

ProtocolRevenue.Performance Fees: The platform's performance-fee cut of those trading fees, set per-vault by PlatformConfig and capped by the vault owner.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees: The vault owner's (LP's) net share of trading fees, after the platform's cut.

methodology.Volume: Swap volume is back-calculated from fees received by the Yieldzio fee wallet. The standard fees use a 0.02% rate ($1 per $5,000). AVLT fees on Ethereum and HyperEVM use a 0.1% rate ($1 of fees per $1,000 of volume) due to the majority of the AVLT volume coming from the liquidation service which charges a 10bps fee.
methodology.Fees: All ERC-20 payments (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the Yieldzio fee wallet are counted as fees.
methodology.UserFees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.
methodology.Revenue: 100% of fees (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the fee wallet are protocol revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 100% of fees (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the fee wallet are protocol revenue.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.

methodology.Fees: Transfer tax (0.95% default, higher during the anti-whale decay window after launch) charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens, valued in WETH at the launch pair spot rate. The Uniswap v2 pair fee is not counted.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees: the transfer tax is paid by token senders.
methodology.Revenue: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps of the 95bps tax, 30bps when a referrer is set), split 10% treasury / 90% governance. Revenue from non-Ethereum chains is bridged weekly to Ethereum, where the split applies (net of bridge fees).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury 10% of the Boardwalk share, plus governance epoch budgets that weekly votes direct to the treasury or into permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity (recognized when the epoch executes on Ethereum).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The portion of the governance 90% recognized when each weekly epoch executes on Ethereum with a holder-accruing outcome chosen by sbfBWLK-weighted votes: BWLK buyback-and-burn or distribution to voters.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Tax shares accruing to launch issuers, stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP, referrers and integrators.

Fees.Token Tax: Transfer tax charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens.

UserFees.Token Tax: Transfer tax paid by token senders.

Revenue.Token Tax To Protocol: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps, 30bps when a referrer is set).

ProtocolRevenue.Token Tax To Treasury: 10% of the Boardwalk share, forwarded to the treasury (BoardwalkFeeCollector.GOVERNANCE_BPS).
ProtocolRevenue.Governance Epochs To Treasury: Weekly governance epoch budgets whose winning vote (or forced fallback) sends the WETH to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked BWLK Liquidity: Epoch budgets used to buy BWLK and mint permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity.

HoldersRevenue.BWLK Buyback Burns: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and burned to the dead address.
HoldersRevenue.Voter Distributions: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and streamed to the epoch's voters.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Creators: Launch issuer's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To LP Stakers: Share streamed to stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP via LPStaking fee epochs (default 15bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Referrers: Referrer's share, carved out of the Boardwalk share on Advanced launches (up to 5bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Integrators: Share split across the five integrator slots (10bps total).

methodology.Fees: Messaging Fees paid by users to cover gas costs for cross-chain messaging, revenue is not calculated as exact costs can't be derived from the logs.

Fees.Messaging Fees: Messaging Fees paid by users to cover gas costs for cross-chain messaging.

methodology.Volume: Gross sell-token amounts routed through HojswapRouterV2, read from its SwapExecuted events. Underlying DEX volume is not attributed as House of Joshi liquidity.
methodology.Fees: The 1% House fee paid by users on swaps executed through HojswapRouterV2, using the exact feeAmount emitted for each trade.
methodology.Revenue: All House swap fees are retained by the protocol; there is no supply-side fee allocation.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All the House swap fees are retained by the protocol.

Fees.Swap Fees: The feeAmount emitted by HojswapRouterV2 for each completed swap.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The full House fee sent to the protocol's configured House wallet.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The full House fee retained by the protocol.

methodology.Volume: Input value of every order placed on the Hyperbridge IntentGateway (same-chain and cross-chain), counted on the source chain.
methodology.Fees: 0.05% protocol fee deducted from order inputs at placement.
methodology.Revenue: The 0.05% protocol fee, retained by the gateway.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 0.05% protocol fee, retained by the gateway.

Fees.Protocol Fees: 0.05% of each order input, deducted at placement (DustCollected events in placement txs).

Revenue.Protocol Fees To Treasury: Protocol fee retained by the gateway, swept by governance.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees To Treasury: Protocol fee retained by the gateway, swept by governance.

methodology.Fees: 0.35% redeem fee on private transfers (withheld from the gross amount before zAssets are minted to the recipient, live since 2026-06-02) plus liquidity-based unwrap fees charged by the LiquidityManagers.
methodology.Revenue: All fees (redeem and unwrap) are retained by the protocol: the redeem fee is never minted, and unwrap fees accrue to the LiquidityManager fee surplus.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All fees (redeem and unwrap) are retained by the protocol.

Fees.Redeem Fees: 0.35% of the gross private-transfer amount, derived from Teleport mints as minted * 0.35 / 99.65.
Fees.Unwrap Fees: feeAmount from LiquidityManager Unwrapped events; the rate rises as liquidity falls below target (zBNB is exempt).

Revenue.Redeem Fees: Redeem fee withheld by the protocol.
Revenue.Unwrap Fees: Unwrap fees added to the LiquidityManager fee surplus.

ProtocolRevenue.Redeem Fees: Redeem fee withheld by the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Unwrap Fees: Unwrap fees added to the LiquidityManager fee surplus.

methodology.UserFees: Fees paid directly by Denaria users to Denaria: the GMX UI fee and the flat service fee. Affiliate rewards are excluded because they are a rebate out of the fee the trader pays to GMX.
methodology.Fees: Fees collected by Denaria: the GMX UI fee charged on Denaria orders, the affiliate reward earned by the DENARIA referral code on GMX position fees, and the flat per-operation service fee paid to the Denaria fee wallet. GMX position, borrowing and funding fees are not Denaria fees and are counted under GMX V2 Perps.
methodology.Revenue: All Denaria fees (GMX UI fees, affiliate rewards, service fees) are revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All revenue (GMX UI fees, affiliate rewards, service fees) accrues to the Denaria fee wallets.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: None: Denaria has no token.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: None: Denaria has no liquidity providers of its own on GMX.
methodology.Volume: Notional USD size of every GMX V2 position increase or decrease on a Denaria position, from the PositionFeesCollected event: orders placed through Denaria (identified by the Denaria uiFeeReceiver) plus liquidations and ADL executed by GMX keepers on positions carrying the DENARIA referral code. Same basis as GMX V2 marginVolumeUsd; this volume is also counted by GMX V2 Perps.

Fees.UI Fees: GMX uiFee (uiFeeFactor x trade size) paid by Denaria traders to the Denaria uiFeeReceiver.
Fees.Affiliate Rewards: Affiliate share of GMX position fees paid to the owner of the DENARIA referral code.
Fees.Service Fees: Flat per-operation USDC service fee charged by the Denaria app (GMX operations and wallet transfers), received by the Denaria fee Safe.

UserFees.UI Fees: GMX uiFee paid by Denaria traders.
UserFees.Service Fees: Flat per-operation USDC service fee paid by Denaria users.

Revenue.UI Fees: GMX uiFee paid to the Denaria uiFeeReceiver.
Revenue.Affiliate Rewards: Affiliate rewards paid to the DENARIA referral code owner.
Revenue.Service Fees: Service fees received by the Denaria fee Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.UI Fees: GMX uiFee paid to the Denaria uiFeeReceiver.
ProtocolRevenue.Affiliate Rewards: Affiliate rewards paid to the DENARIA referral code owner.
ProtocolRevenue.Service Fees: Service fees received by the Denaria fee Safe.

methodology.Fees: 1% (100 bps) app fee charged on swaps routed through Relay, collected in USDC. Reported per origin chain of the swap.
methodology.Revenue: All app fees accrue to the Based protocol; there is no supply-side or holder share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Identical to Revenue: the full app fee is kept by the protocol.

Fees.Swap app fees: 100 bps fee applied to swap volume routed through Relay.

Revenue.Swap app fees: 100 bps fee applied to swap volume routed through Relay.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap app fees: 100 bps fee applied to swap volume routed through Relay.

methodology.Fees: The 0.25% integrator fee HyperDex charges on every swap, bridge and basket order routed through LI.FI: the FeesForwarded leg paid to HyperDex in a transaction whose LI.FI event carries integrator "hyperdex".
methodology.Revenue: All of the integrator fee goes to HyperDex.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of the integrator fee goes to HyperDex.

Fees.Integrator fee: The 0.25% integrator fee paid to HyperDex on each LI.FI-routed order.

Revenue.Integrator fee: The 0.25% integrator fee paid to HyperDex on each LI.FI-routed order.

ProtocolRevenue.Integrator fee: The 0.25% integrator fee paid to HyperDex on each LI.FI-routed order.

methodology.Fees: Assessment fees paid in USDC.
methodology.Revenue: Assessment fees minus trader payouts and referral and affiliate commissions.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Assessment fees minus trader payouts and referral and affiliate commissions.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Trader payouts and referral and affiliate commissions paid out in USDC.

Fees.Assessment Fees: All USDC received by Hypernova's assessment treasury, except transfers from its own reserves, vault and contracts.

Revenue.Net Assessment Fees: Assessment fees minus trader payouts and referral and affiliate commissions.

ProtocolRevenue.Net Assessment Fees: Assessment fees minus trader payouts and referral and affiliate commissions.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral & Affiliate Commissions: USDC paid to affiliates from Hypernova's referral wallet.
SupplySideRevenue.Trader Payouts: Profits paid to traders from the payout vault.

methodology.Volume: Input amount of every swap routed through the vfat SwapRouter contracts, including swaps made by vfat Sickle smart wallets during zaps, rebalances and compounds. Excludes swaps by the vfat fee collector.
methodology.Fees: The router fee (1 basis point of the output amount) paid by users on every swap.
methodology.UserFees: The router fee (1 basis point of the output amount) paid by users on every swap.
methodology.Revenue: All router fees go to the vfat.io fee collector.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All router fees go to the vfat.io fee collector.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Router fee taken from the output token of each swap.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Router fee taken from the output token of each swap.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees To vfat: Router fees sent to the vfat.io fee collector.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees To vfat: Router fees sent to the vfat.io fee collector.

methodology.Fees: 0.05% of the amount traded, collected by TRDEFI on positions created through its venue. The fee is embedded in the maker's signed order and paid to the receiver address when the position trades, so it is counted as the incoming token transfers it actually is. The fee rail has been in force since 2026-09-25; positions created before that carry no fee and are immutable.
methodology.Revenue: The entire collected trading fee. TRDEFI retains 100% of it, with no share paid to suppliers or holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The entire collected trading fee, retained by TRDEFI.

Fees.Trading Fees: 0.05% protocol fee charged on the amount traded when a position created through TRDEFI trades.

Revenue.Trading Fees: 0.05% protocol fee charged on the amount traded when a position created through TRDEFI trades.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: 0.05% protocol fee charged on the amount traded when a position created through TRDEFI trades, retained by TRDEFI.

methodology.Fees: Jumper platform fees (0-5 bps depending on the assets) paid by users on bridges.
methodology.Revenue: All platform fees are kept by Jumper.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All platform fees are kept by Jumper.

Fees.Bridge Fees: Jumper platform fees on bridges.

Revenue.Bridge Fees: Jumper platform fees on bridges.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees: Jumper platform fees on bridges.

methodology.Fees: Platform fees paid by GDEX users. Solana: received in SOL by the GDEX treasury, 1% of the SOL side of each swap and 0.1% on SOL withdrawals (1% when bridging). EVM chains: the 1% swap fee paid to the GDEX treasury by the KyberSwap router GDEX routes swaps through; EVM transfer and bridge fees are not included.
methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers revenue

Fees.Trading Fees: 1% platform fee on GDEX swaps (Solana: plus 0.1% on SOL withdrawals, 1% when bridging), received by the GDEX treasury: in SOL on Solana, and on EVM chains as the KyberSwap router fee paid to the treasury, mostly in the native coin.

methodology.Volume: Native coin paid on buys and received on sells on ADEXTO bonding curves, gross of fees. Trades by the ADEXTO team's own wallets are excluded.
methodology.Fees: All swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from each Swap event: the creator, curve reserve, buyback and protocol legs. Rates are set per market at launch and never change; the launch presets are 1.00% on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets and 0.40% on factory 0.11.0 markets.
methodology.UserFees: All swap fees paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator leg paid to each market's creator, the reserve leg that stays in the market's curve, and the buyback leg that buys and burns the market's own token.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from the fee legs every Swap event carries.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: The creator leg, claimable only to the market's immutable creator. Launch presets: 0.70% of each trade on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets, 0.10% on factory 0.11.0 markets; actual amounts are read from each Swap event.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Curve Reserves: The depth leg, which stays in the market's curve reserve and raises its price floor.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Token Buyback And Burn: The buyback leg, spent only on buying and burning the market's own token.

methodology.Fees: Gas fees paid by users
methodology.Revenue: Burned coins

base_dexs.hashBasis: SHA-256 of parsed response reserialized compact UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False; not raw HTTP bytes

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, set per pool (roughly 0.01% on stable pools, up to a few percent on volatile pools).

methodology.Volume: On-ramp volume: the USDC delivered to buyers on completed p2p.me buy orders (orderType 0), summed from the OrderCompleted events. On a buy the protocol releases USDC from escrow to the buyer in the same transaction, so the value is verifiable 1:1 on chain. Off-ramp (sell) and payment orders are excluded because their fiat legs settle off chain and the on-chain USDC they involve is escrow funding already captured on the buy side, so counting them would double count. Single-sided on-chain-settled convention, matching the merged zkp2p adapter. Sourced from Dune across Polygon (BrokerFactory, retired 2024) and Base (OrderProcessor then OrderFlowFacet).

methodology.Volume: Bonding-curve trade volume on BasedBid. On EVM chains it is the base-token leg of every Bought and Sold event emitted by the core diamond's TradeFacet — the base token paid in on a buy and paid out on a sell — priced in the base token configured for each meme token (native coin or ERC20). On Solana it is, per trade, the base-token amount (any quote token used by a registered project) moved between the trader and the bonding-curve pool. Post-graduation trading is excluded on both: the curve stops emitting once a token lists, and that volume belongs to the DEX it graduated to.

methodology.Volume: Sum of tokens paid into maker wallets during Aqua swap execution, measured as Pushed events on the Aqua registries (the current AquaRouter and the original developer-release registry). Only the taker-paid side of each swap is counted, to avoid double counting and to include the maker fee (the Pulled side is net of fees and would undercount). Pushed events emitted by strategy deployment (the consecutive run following a Shipped event for the same strategy) only register virtual balances without moving tokens and are excluded.

Recurring subscription payments settled to recipients, summed on-chain from SubscriptionProcessed events of the AxiumPass SubscriptionVault contracts (v1 and v2) on each chain. Only the stablecoins AxiumPass offers at checkout are counted (USDC, USDT, EURC — per-chain allowlist in the adapter): the v1 vault is permissionless on the token argument, so any other ERC-20 that reached it is excluded rather than reported as subscription volume, which keeps the reported figure denominated in the tokens named here. Each counted amount is pulled from the subscriber and forwarded 100% to the recipient in the same transaction. The vaults are non-custodial and charge no on-chain fee, so no fees/revenue is reported. Limitation: the v1 vault is also permissionless on enrolment, so a subscription created from an address to itself is indistinguishable on-chain from a merchant payment and is counted; excluding it would require filtering on AxiumPass's enrolled-recipient set, which is not present in the logs.

methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value to BSTONK holders, paid by the hook in the transaction the fee was taken: BSTONK's own pool pays its creator cut to BSTONK's dividend distributor and burns half of it, and launches carry the BSTONK basket vault as a payee; the vault pays BSTONK holders in rounds. Base only - BSTONK lives on Base.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator's cut of the tax less what the treasury swept and what reached BSTONK holders: the creator's wallets, the launch token's own holders through its dividend distributor, the burn of the launch token and the hook-owned liquidity wedge, as each launch configured them.

methodology.Volume: USDC wagered: both stakes of every market at the moment they lock into escrow (a market is only created on-chain once fully matched). This is betting volume, not deposits — funding a balance is not counted, only money committed to a bet. Each dollar is counted exactly once: the two stakes come from two different bettors, so this is the pot, not the maker/taker double count an orderbook has to halve. Cancelled markets refund the stakes, but the matched notional stays counted, in line with other prediction markets.

methodology.UserFees: All swap, outbound and affiliate fees paid by users when swapping through THORChain (slashing is paid by nodes, not users).
methodology.Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools, gross outbound fees and slashing fees paid into the Reserve, and affiliate fees charged by interfaces/wallets (affiliate fees are attributed to the THORChain native chain). RUNE block-reward emissions and the native tx fee (counted in the THORChain chain fees adapter) are excluded.
methodology.Revenue: The share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before) - value to all RUNE holders - plus protocol-kept income (outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees, developer fund, marketing fund and the 20% directed into protocol-owned liquidity). The node-bonder share of swap fees is treated as a security cost and the LP, affiliate and TCY shares as supplier payments, so none of those count as revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Income kept by the protocol: outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees paid into the Reserve, plus the 5% developer fund, 5% marketing fund and 20% protocol-owned liquidity taken from swap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value to RUNE holders: the share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before), permanently removed from supply - the only component that accrues to every RUNE holder.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Value paid to suppliers: the node-operator (RUNE bonder) share of swap fees set by the Incentive Pendulum (a security cost), the liquidity-provider share of swap fees (LP side of the Incentive Pendulum), affiliate fees passed through to integrators, the 10% of swap fees paid to TCY stakers, and the outbound gas costs reimbursed from the Reserve to nodes.

Fees.Swap Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools.
Fees.Outbound Fees: Gross outbound fees charged to users and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Fees.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Fees.Affiliate Fees: Fees charged by the interface or wallet that built the swap (attributed to the THORChain native chain).

UserFees.Swap Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools.

UserFees.Affiliate Fees: Fees charged by the interface or wallet that built the swap (attributed to the THORChain native chain).

methodology.Fees: 6% on every BidRouter swap-back and marketplace sale, plus (until 2026-07-23) 5% of each claw pull taken by V1/V2 machines at play time. ClawMachineV3 no longer takes a pull-time cut: the full play price goes to the claw finance wallet and Beezie's take is realized as the 6% fee when cards are swapped back through the BidRouter - the same model as Solana, where the claw take is the 6% swap fee alone and the marketplace's 6% is paid out by the Metaplex Core royalties plugin. Trade volume itself is not counted - only Beezie's cut.

Fees.Claw Machine Fees: 5% of play price per pull (V1: on-chain commission field; V2: Played.amount x 5%) - the non-refundable cut after a SWAP-back. Ended 2026-07-23 when ClawMachineV3 moved the cut to swap-back time; not charged on Solana either, where the claw likewise takes its cut on the swap
Fees.Swap Fees: 6% of the buyback value when a user swaps a won item back - through BidRouter on Base (funded by the claw finance wallet since V3), or paid to the claw program's fee wallet on Solana
Fees.Marketplace Fees: 6% on every P2P collectible sale through BidRouter; on Solana, the same 6% paid by the Core royalties plugin, split across Beezie's platform-fee and creator wallets

methodology.Revenue: Robinhood Chain only: 50% of the flat ETH swap fee to the protocol treasury, plus 100% of loan-creation and soft-staking activation ETH fees to the treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Robinhood Chain only: 50% of the flat ETH swap fee to the protocol treasury, plus 100% of loan-creation and soft-staking activation ETH fees to the treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Includes NFTs burned from protocol revenue and staker fees distributed to the NFT stakers plus 50% of the flat oracle-priced ~$2 ETH fee per Robinhood Chain swap that goes to the StonkBrokers StockBooster rewards engine.
methodology.Volume: Sum of buy totalCost and sell grossPayout from NFTBought + NFTSold events across every AMM vault deployed by every live Clutch Anvil factory on Ethereum, Base, ApeChain, and Robinhood Chain (pre-gen-6 V2 + gen-6 + AMMFactoryV3 on each chain that has them; on Robinhood also the Civilization AMMFactoryV3 that hosts the Nightshades faction markets). Matches the full factory set enumerated by anvil.clutch.market.

methodology.Fees: USDC payments received for Mycelia oracle API calls. Each Mycelia API request requires a per-call USDC payment on Base. The adapter tracks USDC Transfer events on Base to two protocol-controlled wallets: (1) the direct settlement wallet for payments via the Mycelia-operated x402 proxy (full gross), and (2) the Orbis marketplace payout wallet, which receives weekly payouts representing 80% of revenue from Orbis-mediated traffic (Orbis retains 20% as a facilitator fee). Transfers where the sender is one of the two Mycelia-controlled wallets are excluded (self-sends and cross-wallet internal transfers).
methodology.Revenue: 100% of fees accrue to the protocol treasury. There is no supply-side, LP, integrator, or token-holder revenue split.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue — all USDC payments accumulate in the protocol-operated receiver wallets.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees — every payment is made directly by an end user (human or autonomous agent) per API call.

Fees.Direct settlement: USDC received via the Mycelia-operated TypeScript x402 proxy (myceliasignal-x402-proxy.service), settling directly to 0xD593832Ce9C2B13B192ba50B55dd9AF44e96700d. Represents full gross fees for direct path traffic.
Fees.Orbis marketplace payouts (80% net): USDC received from the Orbis x402 marketplace facilitator at the configured payout address 0xfF51E0339A17f5fcBa6eAf0E06518d0042ac84bf. Represents 80% of customer payments routed through Orbis (the remaining 20% is retained by Orbis as a facilitator fee). Payouts are batched weekly.

methodology.Volume: Sum of totalAmount (the pre-fee swap notional a user commits, in tokenIn) from every SwapWithFee event emitted by the TeraSwapFeeCollector proxy, the contract that collects the 0.1% on-chain before the trade is forwarded to the underlying DEX router. On Ethereum mainnet this aggregates both FeeCollector deployments — the frozen V1 contract and the live V2 contract that replaced it — so mainnet's reported history is continuous back to TeraSwap's first on-chain swap rather than starting at the V2 cutover. Not all TeraSwap volume reaches that contract: routes filled by 0x, CoW Swap and Bebop collect the identical 0.1% through those venues' own partner-fee parameters instead of the FeeCollector, emit no SwapWithFee event, and are therefore NOT counted here.

methodology.Revenue: The 1inch DAO's encoded share of each fill's swap fee: 1/4 of the LP fee on low-fee tiers (below ~0.1225%) and 1/6 on higher tiers, transferred to the purpose-deployed per-chain DAO fee exchanger at fill time. Positions created before the DAO fee launch (2026-07-19; enabled 2026-07-21 on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain) carry no DAO fee and contribute only to SupplySideRevenue. Cross-checked against measured ERC20 inflows to the fee exchangers.

methodology.Fees: Safety Deposit Box liquidity-locker protocol cuts (Uniswap V3/V4 + up. DEX v2/CL lockers) from LockFeesCollected / LockLiquidityDecreased / LockTokensPaid; LP trading fees claimed through the locked positions (the lock owner's 80% share of LockFeesCollected plus gauge rewards from LockTokensPaid); and StonkVestingLocker 0.01% deposit fees.

methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 90% of locker protocol cuts → SafetyDepositClockIn broker claims, and the lock owners' 80% share of locked-LP trading fees + gauge rewards claimed through the lockers.

methodology.Fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers: for every trade, the face value of the debt (units) minus the loan tokens the borrower received (sellerAssets), i.e. the fixed-rate discount locked in at execution.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol fees kept by Morpho: the settlement fee (taker-paid spread on each trade) plus the continuous fee accrued on new lender credit. Both are disabled at launch, so Revenue is currently 0.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue: settlement fee plus continuous fee. Currently 0 while both fees are disabled.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Interest distributed to lenders: total borrow interest minus the protocol settlement and continuous fees.

Fees.Borrow Interest: Face value (units) minus proceeds to the borrower (sellerAssets) on every trade in listed markets.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: Settlement fee (buyerAssets - sellerAssets) plus continuous fee (buyerPendingFeeIncrease) per trade. Currently 0.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: Settlement fee plus continuous fee per trade. Currently 0.

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: Borrow interest net of protocol settlement and continuous fees, distributed to lenders.

methodology.Fees: On Base/Robinhood: gross Doppler pool trading fees (2.5%), extrapolated from Squeeze’s 47.5% Doppler fee-collect receipts. On Solana: LaunchLab *platform* fees claimed to Squeeze’s claim wallet only (not creator/protocol/referral cuts).
methodology.Revenue: Squeeze platform share — EVM: 47.5% of Doppler swap fees claimed via collectFees; Solana: LaunchLab platform fees to the claim wallet.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Squeeze platform share — EVM: 47.5% of Doppler swap fees claimed via collectFees; Solana: LaunchLab platform fees to the claim wallet.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: On EVM: extrapolated creator share (47.5%) and Doppler protocol-owner share (5%). On Solana: not attributed in v1 (those cuts never hit the Squeeze claim wallet).

Fees.LaunchLab Platform Fees: Solana only — LaunchLab platform fee claims to Squeeze’s claim wallet (platform slice, not gross pool fees).

Revenue.Squeeze Platform Fees: EVM — numeraires received by Squeeze platform wallet from the Doppler fee contracts.
Revenue.LaunchLab Platform Fees: Solana — LaunchLab platform fees received by Squeeze claim wallet.

ProtocolRevenue.Squeeze Platform Fees: EVM — Squeeze platform cut retained by the treasury / platform wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.LaunchLab Platform Fees: Solana — LaunchLab platform fees retained by Squeeze.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Estimated creator share of EVM Doppler pool fees (47.5% of gross).
SupplySideRevenue.Doppler Protocol Fees: Estimated Doppler Airlock protocol-owner share of EVM pool fees (5% of gross).

methodology.Fees: Quote-denominated swap fees from Hook Trade events plus token-launch payment events across configured suites. Legacy launch-token-denominated swap fees are excluded because reliable historical USD valuation is unavailable. Crypto uses token balances; Stocks use the event-time factory tick reference price under the documented $4,000 opening-cap convention, with historical DefiLlama prices only when that reference is unavailable.
methodology.Revenue: Actual platform and protocol-owned fixed-component swap credits, plus token-launch fees. Includes anti-snipe surcharges, referral fallback and rounding retained by the protocol. Claims do not count again.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swap and launch fees retained by the protocol treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Actual swap credits allocated to creators and referrers, including amounts still unclaimed.

Fees.Crypto Swap Fees: Crypto quote-denominated swap fees, including anti-snipe surcharges.
Fees.Crypto Launch Fees: Crypto token-launch fees from Factory payment events.
Fees.Stocks Swap Fees: Stocks quote-denominated swap fees, including anti-snipe surcharges.
Fees.Stocks Launch Fees: Stocks token-launch fees from Factory payment events.

Revenue.Crypto Swap Fees To Protocol: Crypto swap fees credited to the protocol, including treasury-owned fixed components.
Revenue.Crypto Launch Fees To Protocol: Crypto token-launch fees paid to the protocol.

Revenue.Stocks Launch Fees To Protocol: Stocks token-launch fees paid to the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Protocol: Stocks swap fees credited to the protocol, including treasury-owned fixed components.
ProtocolRevenue.Stocks Launch Fees To Protocol: Stocks token-launch fees paid to the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Creators: Stocks swap fees credited to token creators.
SupplySideRevenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Referrers: Stocks swap fees credited to valid referrers.

methodology.Volume: Sum of the input amount of every executed order, taken from the router's OrderExecuted logs. Only the input leg is counted, so a single trade is never counted twice. Cancellations, which the previous router encoded as an OrderExecuted with orderType 255, are excluded.
methodology.Fees: Protocol fee deducted from the output token of each executed order. The rate is signed by the maker as part of the order and capped on-chain at 1%.
methodology.Revenue: All the protocol fees deducted from the output token of each executed order. The router has no liquidity providers, so nothing is shared out.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All the protocol fees deducted from the output token of each executed order. The router has no liquidity providers, so nothing is shared out.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: None. Liquidity is Uniswap's; its pool fees are not counted here.

Fees.Protocol Fees: Protocol fee deducted from the output token of each executed order. The rate is signed by the maker as part of the order payload and capped on-chain at 1%.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: All the protocol fees deducted from the output token of each executed order. The router has no liquidity providers, so nothing is shared out.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: All the protocol fees deducted from the output token of each executed order. The router has no liquidity providers, so nothing is shared out.

methodology.Fees: Total fees paid by users on AGNT: (1) the 1.095% Doppler V4 terminal pool fee on tokens launched via the launchpad on Base + Robinhood Chain, derived from the observed on-chain platform fee share (WETH on Base; WETH plus RWA numeraires — tokenized stocks like AAPL that a Robinhood launch pairs against, e.g. $BEER — on Robinhood, priced by DefiLlama; the unpriced launched-token leg is excluded, a conservative lower bound); plus (2) the 0.40% platform fee on in-app swaps (Base), measured as WETH + USDC paid by Relay to AGNT's app-fee recipient wallet; plus (3) fees from PonsV2 launches on Robinhood Chain, read from each token's AgntFeeWedge Split events (native-ETH leg = total user-paid fee); plus (4) native-ETH paid by buyers to mint AGNT's own AGNTS PFP collection on Robinhood Chain; plus (5) AGNTS activation fees on Robinhood Chain (ETH fee + $AGNTS cost, from the Activated event); plus (6) AGNTS NFT swap fees on Robinhood Chain (random packs and exact picks; the fee is read from the swap engine at each swap's block).
methodology.Revenue: Fees kept by AGNT: the 32% platform share of launchpad pool fees (WETH released by the Doppler initializers on Base + Robinhood, to 0x5bF5805e…C5f0) plus 100% of the 0.40% swap fee (WETH + USDC paid by Relay on Base to the app-fee recipient wallets — 0x585b6854…0598 pre-repoint and 0x5bF5805e…C5f0 post-repoint) plus AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) protocol cut of PonsV2 launch fees on Robinhood (the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split; the remaining 5/7 is forwarded to each token's own engine) plus 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds on Robinhood (a first-party collection, so there is no creator split) plus 100% of AGNTS activation ETH fees and swap fees, and the full $AGNTS activation cost (the treasury share plus the burned share).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue kept by the AGNT treasury: everything in Revenue except the burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of each AGNTS activation's $AGNTS cost that is burned (burnBps, 50% today).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 68% of launchpad pool fees paid to third-party token creators (63%) and the Doppler protocol (~5%), estimated from the observed platform WETH share.

Fees.Launchpad Fees: 1.095% Doppler terminal fee (WETH leg), estimated as platform WETH share / 0.32, on Base + Robinhood Chain.
Fees.Trading Fees: 0.40% swap fee (Base), WETH + USDC paid by Relay to the app-fee recipient wallet.
Fees.Pons Launchpad Fees: PonsV2 launch fees on Robinhood Chain (native-ETH leg), the `total` of each token's AgntFeeWedge Split event.
Fees.NFT Mint Fees: Native ETH paid by buyers minting AGNT's own AGNTS PFP collection on Robinhood Chain, measured as proceeds withdrawn from the mint controller.
Fees.Activation Fees: ETH fee paid to activate an AGNTS NFT (Robinhood), from the Activated event.
Fees.Activation $AGNTS: $AGNTS paid to activate an AGNTS NFT (Robinhood), from the Activated event.
Fees.NFT Swap Fees: ETH fee for AGNTS NFT swaps (random packs and exact picks) on Robinhood, read from the swap engine at each swap's block.

Revenue.Launchpad Fees to Protocol: 32% platform share, WETH released to the fee wallet on Base + Robinhood
Revenue.Trading Fees to Protocol: 100% of the 0.40% swap fee, WETH + USDC paid by Relay to the app-fee recipient (Base)
Revenue.Pons Fees to Protocol: AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) cut of PonsV2 launch fees, the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split (Robinhood).
Revenue.NFT Mint Fees to Protocol: 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds (Robinhood) — a first-party collection, so AGNT keeps all of it.
Revenue.Activation Fees to Protocol: 100% of the AGNTS activation ETH fee (Robinhood).
Revenue.Activation $AGNTS to Protocol: The non-burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost, sent to the treasury (Robinhood).
Revenue.Activation $AGNTS Burned: The burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost (Robinhood).

ProtocolRevenue.Launchpad Fees to Protocol: 32% platform share, WETH released to the fee wallet on Base + Robinhood
ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees to Protocol: 100% of the 0.40% swap fee, WETH + USDC paid by Relay to the app-fee recipient (Base)
ProtocolRevenue.Pons Fees to Protocol: AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) cut of PonsV2 launch fees, the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split (Robinhood).
ProtocolRevenue.NFT Mint Fees to Protocol: 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds (Robinhood) — a first-party collection, so AGNT keeps all of it.
ProtocolRevenue.Activation Fees to Protocol: 100% of the AGNTS activation ETH fee (Robinhood).
ProtocolRevenue.Activation $AGNTS to Protocol: The non-burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost, sent to the treasury (Robinhood).

HoldersRevenue.Activation $AGNTS Burned: The burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost (Robinhood).

SupplySideRevenue.Launchpad Fees to Creators: 63% of launchpad pool fees paid to third-party token creators
SupplySideRevenue.Launchpad Fees to Doppler: 5% of launchpad pool fees paid to the Doppler protocol
SupplySideRevenue.Pons Fees to Engine: The ~5/7 (71.43%) of each PonsV2 launch fee forwarded from the AgntFeeWedge to the token's own engine (Robinhood).

methodology.Fees: Gross USDC product payments (subscriptions, pay-per-deploy, Architect builds, first-party agent income) entering the on-chain revenue splitter, summed from PaymentSplit events.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of every payment — operating, dev, protocol-owned-liquidity reserve and DAO buckets — i.e. gross payments minus third-party affiliate payouts.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue: all non-affiliate buckets are protocol-controlled.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 3-level affiliate share (6% / 2.5% / 1.5%) credited to third-party referrers, from AffiliateCredited events.

Fees.Product payments: Gross USDC entering the FrostyRevenueSplitter via PaymentSplit events — subscriptions, pay-per-deploy, Architect builds and first-party agent income.

ProtocolRevenue.Payments to operating, dev, POL reserve: Gross payments minus affiliate payouts — the operating, dev, POL reserve and DAO buckets.

SupplySideRevenue.Affiliate payouts: USDC credited to third-party referrers via AffiliateCredited events (3-level: 6% / 2.5% / 1.5%).

methodology.Fees: Borrow interest paid by borrowers on Bitcoin-collateralised USDC loans.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol reserve share of borrow interest (reserveRateBps), from the protocolCut field of the InterestAccrued event.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol reserve share of borrow interest (reserveRateBps), from the protocolCut field of the InterestAccrued event.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Borrow interest distributed to USDC liquidity providers (LPs), from the lenderCut field of the InterestAccrued event.

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: Borrow interest distributed to USDC liquidity providers (LPs), from the lenderCut field of the InterestAccrued event.

methodology.Fees: Transfer tax (0.95% default, higher during the anti-whale decay window after launch) charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens, valued in WETH at the launch pair spot rate. The Uniswap v2 pair fee is not counted.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees: the transfer tax is paid by token senders.
methodology.Revenue: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps of the 95bps tax, 30bps when a referrer is set), split 10% treasury / 90% governance. Revenue from non-Ethereum chains is bridged weekly to Ethereum, where the split applies (net of bridge fees).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury 10% of the Boardwalk share, plus governance epoch budgets that weekly votes direct to the treasury or into permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity (recognized when the epoch executes on Ethereum).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The portion of the governance 90% recognized when each weekly epoch executes on Ethereum with a holder-accruing outcome chosen by sbfBWLK-weighted votes: BWLK buyback-and-burn or distribution to voters.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Tax shares accruing to launch issuers, stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP, referrers and integrators.

Fees.Token Tax: Transfer tax charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens.

UserFees.Token Tax: Transfer tax paid by token senders.

Revenue.Token Tax To Protocol: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps, 30bps when a referrer is set).

ProtocolRevenue.Token Tax To Treasury: 10% of the Boardwalk share, forwarded to the treasury (BoardwalkFeeCollector.GOVERNANCE_BPS).
ProtocolRevenue.Governance Epochs To Treasury: Weekly governance epoch budgets whose winning vote (or forced fallback) sends the WETH to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked BWLK Liquidity: Epoch budgets used to buy BWLK and mint permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity.

HoldersRevenue.BWLK Buyback Burns: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and burned to the dead address.
HoldersRevenue.Voter Distributions: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and streamed to the epoch's voters.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Creators: Launch issuer's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To LP Stakers: Share streamed to stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP via LPStaking fee epochs (default 15bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Referrers: Referrer's share, carved out of the Boardwalk share on Advanced launches (up to 5bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Integrators: Share split across the five integrator slots (10bps total).

methodology.Fees: Uniswap V3 swap fees generated by Goon-launched pools (pools with under $100 TVL are excluded as dust).
methodology.Revenue: The USD share of swap fees, minus whatever Uniswap's protocol fee switch (read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol) diverts to Uniswap itself.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The token share of swap fees paid to the token creator, plus Uniswap's diverted cut of both swap fee legs (read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol).

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Uniswap V3 swap fees generated by Goon-launched pools, split by which side of the swap was the input: USD-input fees (to protocol/Uniswap) and Token-input fees (to creator/Uniswap). Pools with under $100 TVL are excluded as dust.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees to Protocol: Swap fees charged when USD was the input token, minus Uniswap's live per-pool protocol fee cut, accrue to the protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Protocol: Swap fees charged when USD was the input token, minus Uniswap's live per-pool protocol fee cut, accrue to the protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Creators: Swap fees charged when the Token was the input token, minus Uniswap's live per-pool protocol fee cut, accrue to the token creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Uniswap: Uniswap's protocol fee switch cut of both swap fee legs, read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol - no longer reaches Goon's protocol or the token creator.

methodology.Fees: Messaging Fees paid by users to cover gas costs for cross-chain messaging, revenue is not calculated as exact costs can't be derived from the logs.

Fees.Messaging Fees: Messaging Fees paid by users to cover gas costs for cross-chain messaging.

methodology.Volume: Gross sell-token amounts routed through HojswapRouterV2, read from its SwapExecuted events. Underlying DEX volume is not attributed as House of Joshi liquidity.
methodology.Fees: The 1% House fee paid by users on swaps executed through HojswapRouterV2, using the exact feeAmount emitted for each trade.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All the House swap fees are retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The full House fee retained by the protocol.

methodology.Fees: EVM token launch fees plus Uniswap v4 LP swap fees harvested from ZNS-launched pools; on Solana, wSOL-denominated Meteora DBC trading, protocol, and routing-referral fees paid by traders in the three wSOL production configs. DBC fees collected in a newly launched base token are excluded because that token cannot be reliably priced.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees retained by ZNS: EVM launch fees and the exact treasury shares booked by the EVM fee locker; on Solana, the fixed 40% treasury share of ZNS partner trading fees. Solana no-referrer fallback is conservatively excluded until splitter distribution events are indexed by Dune.

Fees.Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders in ZNS-launched Uniswap v4 and Meteora DBC pools.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To ZNS Treasury: Swap fees allocated to the ZNS treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Meteora: Meteora protocol share of Solana DBC swap fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Routing Referrers: Meteora referral fee paid to swap-routing frontends.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of swap fees collected by the protocol.

methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Share of swap fees to LPs.

methodology.Fees: The tax BaseStonk's Uniswap v4 hook takes on every swap in a launched token's pool, from the hook's FeeTaken event. Each launch sets its own buy and sell rate. A buy pays the tax in the launch token and a sell in the pair; token-denominated amounts are converted into the pair at the pool price the same transaction's Swap reports.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's cut of the tax plus what reaches BSTONK holders: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade to the treasury, any part of the creator's cut the payee list left unplaced and the hook swept to the treasury, and the share of the creator's cut paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor, to the BSTONK basket vault, or burnt as BSTONK.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury's take: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade, plus unplaced creator fees swept to it.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value to BSTONK holders, paid by the hook in the transaction the fee was taken: BSTONK's own pool pays its creator cut to BSTONK's dividend distributor and burns half of it, and launches carry the BSTONK basket vault as a payee; the vault pays BSTONK holders in rounds. Base only - BSTONK lives on Base.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator's cut of the tax less what the treasury swept and what reached BSTONK holders: the creator's wallets, the launch token's own holders through its dividend distributor, the burn of the launch token and the hook-owned liquidity wedge, as each launch configured them.
methodology.Volume: The pair side of every swap in a taxed pool, including the creator's dev buy at launch and excluding the hook's own buyback and liquidity swaps. Counted under Uniswap v4 as well.

Revenue.Basket Dividends To BSTONK Holders: Paid by the hook to the BSTONK basket vault as a payee on launches.
Revenue.BSTONK Burn: BSTONK the hook burnt from BSTONK's own pool: the launch token on buys, bought back on sells.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The platform's cut of the tax: half of it, capped at 1% of the trade, paid to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Unplaced Creator Fees To Treasury: The part of the creator's cut the launch's payee list left unplaced, swept to the treasury.
